name: badge
description: A small label for a status or a count, like New, Paid, or 3. Not interactive: use a tag for input. Can sit on the corner of its parent as a notification count.

props.variant: primary, warning, danger, info, or notice. Adds badge--primary, badge--warning, badge--danger, badge--info, or badge--notice. With no variant, the badge is neutral.
props.notification: left or right. Adds badge--notification-left or badge--notification-right: the badge sits on that top corner of its parent, with a ring in the page color. The parent needs position: relative.
props.children: The text, and optional icons before or after it.

props.name: The icon's name. Takes every Icon prop. The badge sets its size with --op-badge-icon-size. Plain HTML: add badge__icon to the icon.

modifiers.badge--notification-left: On the top left corner of the parent, with a ring
modifiers.badge--notification-right: On the top right corner of the parent, with a ring

customPropertiesNote: Border and ring values are box shadows. Use var(--op-border-none) to draw nothing. Each variant sets only the background and color. Make a new variant with a modifier class that sets these two variables.

badge.--op-badge-gap: Space between the text and icons
badge.--op-badge-ring-color: Color of the ring around a notification badge. Set it to the color behind the parent
badge.--op-badge-ring: The ring. Only a notification badge draws one by default

badge__icon.--op-badge-icon-size: Size of an icon in the badge
